comparison_caveat: V37/V38's published 2/7 V5 scores used the V39 ablation system prompt. This Qwen run used the default system prompt, so the scores are not a controlled head-to-head comparison.
decision: Pi tool-call transport works and Q4 inference is usable at about 15 tokens/s, but Kof task reliability is not acceptable for daily-driver use (1/7 V5, 0/1 typed holdout). Do not promote or claim Kof competence. Xenolith compatibility with this Qwen checkpoint remains untested; current Xenolith evidence is for Gemma 4, so llama.cpp is the verified Qwen path.
